case-db-mcp._comment: Local Python MCP server exposing generic CRUD tools over data/case_management.db. This server itself is NOT identity-aware; on-behalf-of caseworker scoping is enforced by agents/case_management_agent/graph.py, which wraps these tools before exposing anything to the LLM. No external secrets required.

tools.name: db_read_record
tools.description: Fetches rows matching query_params from 'cases' or 'case_notes'.

query_params.description: Column-value pairs to filter by, e.g. {"case_id": "CASE-2026-001"}.

tools.name: db_create_record
tools.description: Inserts a new row into 'cases' or 'case_notes'.

tools.name: db_update_record
tools.description: Updates an existing row in 'cases' or 'case_notes'.

key_value.description: Value of key_field identifying the row.
